newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 97/98 budget may reach 1 trln baht - official.
newsitem.headline: Thai 97/98 budget may reach 1 trln baht - official.

text.p: Thailand's budget for fiscal 1997/98 (October-September) could rise by 11-12 percent from 1996/97 to reach one trillion baht ($40 billion), the head of the budget bureau said on Monday.
Seri Suksathaporn told reporters that related government agencies such as the finance ministry, the Bank of Thailand and the budget bureau would hold a meeting on the budget next week.
The possible increase in the budget will be lower than that for fiscal 1996/97, which rose 16.7 percent from the previous year to 984 billion baht.
"The 1997/98 budget will also be balanced. Any rise in the spending will be based on the economic growth and the growth of infrastructure investment," he said.
"But austerity and cautious spending will continue to be the key issue," he added.
Thailand has run a deficit-free budget over the past decade.
